authority: User requested additional useful spatial measurements, persistent outline and best available visual detail. These six additions are separate from the original thirteen PDF measurements.

measurements.label: Section PLA share
measurements.definition: 100 × bin PLA count / whole same-section PLA count
measurements.empty_bin: zero when the section has PLA; undefined if the entire section PLA total is zero
measurements.interpretation: Relative spatial allocation within each section, not tissue-area density or absolute concentration

measurements.label: Marker-associated PLA area fraction
measurements.definition: Sum area of marker-associated PLA / sum area of all PLA in the section-bin
measurements.empty_bin: undefined when total PLA area is zero
measurements.interpretation: Area-weighted association; not fraction of tissue or molecular binding
measurements.required_validity: All PLA areas and association flags must be valid

measurements.label: Median PLA intensity
measurements.definition: Type-7 linear median of PLA Average Intensity in a section-bin
measurements.interpretation: Robust exported intensity summary; acquisition/segmentation/normalization unverified

measurements.label: PLA area interquartile range
measurements.definition: Type-7 area percentile 75 minus percentile 25 in a section-bin
measurements.empty_bin: undefined without PLA; one object yields zero IQR
measurements.interpretation: Within-bin spread of detected object size

measurements.label: PLA area coefficient of variation
measurements.definition: Population area standard deviation (ddof=0) / mean area; at least two objects and positive mean
measurements.interpretation: Relative within-bin size variability; unstable with sparse objects or small mean

measurements.label: Mean PLA nearest-neighbor distance
measurements.definition: Per-object Euclidean distance to the nearest other PLA object in the same entire section, then mean of focal-object distances within each bin
measurements.empty_bin: undefined without focal PLA or when same-section neighbor is unavailable
measurements.interpretation: Descriptive spacing of detected bounding-box midpoint proxies in exported coordinate units
measurements.limits: Depends on detection density, segmentation and unobserved objects beyond the section; not calibrated physical distance, cell spacing, colocalization or statistical clustering

biological_unit: Three distinct animal sections per condition within each arm; same animals across two arms. Objects do not increase independent biological N.
averaging: Compute each statistic per section and bin, then equal mean of defined section values within condition; no pooled-object condition mean.

context.source: Finest original 100-unit union of bins containing PLA or ChAT detections across six sections, separately per arm
context.fill: Pale detected-object footprint beneath selected finite measurement tiles

resolution.local_method: Rebin exact unsampled cached PLA coordinates and matching attributes; preserve whole-section totals and full-section nearest-neighbor distances

exports.svg: Independent vector tiles plus footprint and boundary paths, not a screenshot or embedded raster heatmap

unchanged: Observed support and uncertain coverage policy
